name: M-2 toll plaza canopy
assumptions: The dossier has no position; placed on OSM way 1445457796 (building=roof, Toll Plaza) at the Lahore end near Babu Sabu, the only M-2 canopy with a mapped outline found.
Footprint 39.6 by 10.5 m is that OSM polygon; which way it faces is inferred from the east-west link roads under it, with the front on the eastern approach (heading about 80.6).
OSM tags height 5, taken as a roofline guess; photos give about 5.5 m clear at the belly and 8.75 m to the top of the board (ratios against booths and struts, no measured figure).
This exact canopy was not found in any photo; its form is the FWO/NHA plaza family seen at other M-2 and M-1 plazas. Ravi plaza is a different, square-columned design and is not modelled.
Seven lanes, eight islands at 5.4 m pitch: fitted to the 39.6 m polygon, the lane count is not published.
White struts follow the M-2 plaza photos; the Islamabad plaza has yellow or red struts, so colour varies by plaza.
Strut section, bow, foot positions (2.7 m each side of the booth) and plinth size are read off oblique photos.
Belly profile and soffit colour estimated from Islamabad plaza photos; the night glow on the soffit comes from the Ravi aerial photo.
The green board is left blank because the wording at this canopy is unknown. Only one face has been seen; the back is assumed green.
Booths 1.8 by 3.0 by 2.55 m on seven islands, one per lane; island length 22 m and all colours are visual estimates.
No lane barriers, cameras, kerb signs or road surface: the game supplies the road and barriers were not confirmed for this canopy.
